nodes.label: Checked system map
nodes.summary: Preserve domain meaning through typed structure, exact realization, observation, and bounded evidence.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A checked map is not proof of business truth, runtime correctness, or release authority.

nodes.label: Typed domain graph
nodes.summary: Domain concepts typed by DS-D1 and connected by DS-D8-admitted relationships.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Graph membership does not select implementation bytes or prove observed behavior.

nodes.label: Exact realization continuity
nodes.summary: One selected language realization remains byte-bound from source intent through target evidence.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A similar filename, symbol, or code shape is not the selected realization.

nodes.label: Non-inflating evidence
nodes.summary: Combined evidence cannot support a claim larger than its exact observations and inputs.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Unsupported, missing, stale, or unknown evidence cannot become PASS.

nodes.label: Workflow Compensation
nodes.summary: Umbrella forward-recovery model over immutable intent, frozen plan, exact Operations, durable coordination, replay protection, and explicit terminal meaning.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Not a new meta-type, relationship verb, database rollback, or proof that durable runtime machinery is implemented.

nodes.label: Recovery Intent
nodes.summary: Immutable identity and required, satisfied, or unresolved semantic state for one Workflow failure occurrence.
nodes.forbidden_inference: An intent is not a queue item, worker attempt, claim, lease, or proof of execution.

nodes.label: Durable Compensation Dispatch
nodes.summary: Durable frozen-plan progress and coordination state across restart and worker replacement.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Canonical dispatch semantics do not prove that a durable dispatcher exists.

nodes.label: Compensation Execution Attempt
nodes.summary: One bounded execution episode with succeeded, failed, or unknown outcome.
nodes.forbidden_inference: One attempt outcome is not the semantic or terminal result of the whole recovery.

nodes.label: Compensation Invocation Identity
nodes.summary: Stable per-plan-occurrence identity reused across attempts for at-most-once semantic application.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A stable key does not promise exactly-once invocation or replace Claim coordination.

nodes.label: Compensation Claim
nodes.summary: CAS-acquired current worker authority with monotonic fencing for one dispatch.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A Claim is not its Lease, domain ownership, Operation authority, or replay protection.

nodes.label: Compensation Claim Lease
nodes.summary: Renewable time-bounded validity for one Claim, enabling recovery after worker loss.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Lease renewal is not retry and Lease expiry is not a business failure.

nodes.label: Compensation Retry
nodes.summary: Bounded scheduling of a successor attempt under an explicit Operation-owned continuation.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Retry cannot replan, substitute an Operation, or rotate Invocation Identity.

nodes.label: Compensation Terminal Disposition
nodes.summary: Durable completed, exhausted, or escalated result for the whole recovery.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Terminal recording grants no implicit successor, publication, or deployment authority.

nodes.label: Concern-Specific Dependency Contract
nodes.summary: One consumer-owned code seam named for one responsibility, with provider mechanics supplied only at a composition boundary.
nodes.forbidden_inference: This is not a universal Port, mandatory DomainSpec Interface, DI container, service locator, or provider selection.

nodes.label: Persistence Binding
nodes.summary: Bind exact logical persistence roles and one concern-specific contract to one selected adapter, resource, profile, mapping, and evidence boundary.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A Repository shape is not a Persistence Binding, and the binding does not prove database durability or atomicity.

nodes.label: Transaction Guarantee Binding
nodes.summary: Declare one exact local Unit of Work, participant set, selected guarantees, failure binding, profile, and evidence boundary.
nodes.forbidden_inference: The binding does not create Workflow-wide or distributed atomicity and does not absorb Operation-owned business state.

nodes.label: Failure Outcome Binding
nodes.summary: Classify one provider or integration outcome as retryable, non-retryable, or unknown while preserving raw evidence and continuation ownership.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Failure classification cannot choose Retry, erase unknown state, or select successor work.

nodes.label: Durable Workflow Runtime Binding
nodes.summary: Compose the exact persistence, transaction, failure, scheduling, clock, wakeup, replay, restart, and version surfaces required by one durable Workflow profile.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Synchronous Workflows do not inherit this binding, and the binding selects no runtime, database, queue, or provider.

nodes.label: DS-D1 Meta-Type System
nodes.summary: Thirteen active backend semantic roles plus explicitly non-active retained UI state.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Semantic maturity is independent of realization admission and target conformance.

nodes.label: DS-D8 Relationship Authority
nodes.summary: Typed endpoint, scope, multiplicity, lifecycle, and projection-authorship constraints.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Imports, calls, fields, and diagram arrows cannot author new semantic relationships.

nodes.label: Canonical Implemented Meta-Type Baseline @10
nodes.summary: Immutable selection of 13 backend types, 39 realization rows, 847 first-class evidence files, corrected Workflow recovery, and provider-neutral D45-D49 formation machinery.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Baseline admission does not claim a provider or the durable compensation runtime is implemented and grants no publication or deployment authority.

nodes.label: Meta-Type Instantiation CLI
nodes.summary: Decode, select, plan, publish atomically, receipt, reread, and observe supported target artifacts.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A successful process exit alone is not instantiation or conformance.

nodes.label: Target Conformance Observer
nodes.summary: Compare generated target artifacts with exact selected contract markers and fail closed on drift or unsupported evidence.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Static observation does not prove production runtime behavior.

nodes.label: Baseline-Bound Instantiation Receipt
nodes.summary: Bind input, selected realization, plan, outputs, reread observations, and conformance result.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A receipt cannot repair missing observations or authorize its own next effect.

nodes.label: Operation Runtime Contract
nodes.summary: Own declared reads, writes, effects, guard ordering, atomic state-and-outbox behavior, Events, and failure continuation.
nodes.forbidden_inference: An Operation contract does not grant an executor undeclared effects.

nodes.label: Workflow Runtime Contract
nodes.summary: Coordinate ordered Operations and emit Recovery Intent while generated TypeScript, Python, and Rust targets delegate exact-plan invocation to an external executor boundary.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Workflow orchestration does not absorb Operation state-changing responsibility, and baseline v10 selects only the bounded generated-source recovery profile, not a provider runtime.

nodes.label: Compensation Planner
nodes.summary: Select exact recovery Operations and derive deterministic dependency-aware order, Recovery Intent identity, plan occurrence identity, and Invocation Identity in TypeScript, Python, and Rust.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Planning does not invoke an Operation, mutate state, or establish durable uniqueness across restarts.

nodes.label: External Compensation Executor
nodes.summary: Preflight every exact frozen-plan binding, invoke ordered recovery Operations, and stop on explicit failure continuation in all three language profiles.
nodes.forbidden_inference: The observed executors are in-process references and do not provide durable claiming, scheduling, provider persistence, or restart recovery.

nodes.label: Portable Durable Recovery Architecture Profile @2
nodes.summary: Thirty technology-neutral properties and findings define the durable Recovery Intent runtime and its research-derived infrastructure bindings while preserving explicit unknown and partial observations.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A canonical architecture profile and its research provenance are not evidence that designed components or providers are implemented.

nodes.label: Recovery Coordination Repository Contract
nodes.summary: Closed provider-neutral concern-specific contract formation for durable Recovery Intent, Dispatch, Claim, Lease, Attempt, Retry, terminal, version, and outbox records.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Implemented contract formation is not a database, adapter, transaction guarantee, or persistence proof.

nodes.label: Recovery Coordination Unit of Work Contract
nodes.summary: Closed provider-neutral concern-specific local coordination state-and-outbox Unit of Work contract formation.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Implemented contract formation cannot span Workflow-wide or Operation-owned business transactions and proves no provider behavior.

nodes.label: Operation Binding Resolver Contract
nodes.summary: Resolve every exact frozen-plan Operation binding before the first invocation in TypeScript, Python, and Rust generated targets through a responsibility-specific seam.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Binding resolution is not a universal dependency Port and grants no undeclared effect or provider authority.

nodes.label: Recovery Persistence Binding
nodes.summary: Closed digest-bound formation binds a Recovery Coordination Repository contract to target-supplied adapter, resource, mapping, profile, and evidence references.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Formation and exact static observation select no database, ORM, migration, connection lifecycle, or persistence behavior.

nodes.label: Recovery Transaction Guarantee Binding
nodes.summary: Closed digest-bound formation records one local Unit of Work, exact participants, selected guarantees, failure binding, and evidence boundary.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Formation does not create Workflow-wide atomicity or prove provider commit, rollback, isolation, or restoration.

nodes.label: Recovery Failure Outcome Binding
nodes.summary: Closed validated formation classifies target-supplied provider outcomes as retryable, non-retryable, or unknown while preserving evidence and continuation ownership.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Classification cannot select Retry, successor work, Terminal Disposition, or prove provider behavior.

nodes.label: Durable Workflow Runtime Binding
nodes.summary: Closed digest-bound D49 formation composes exact persistence, transaction, failure, clock, wakeup, replay, scheduler, and version references and generates contracts in three languages.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Implemented formation is not provider selection or runtime implementation; runtime_guarantees_observed remains false.

nodes.label: Durable Recovery Coordination Store Adapter
nodes.summary: One provider-selected adapter implementing the Repository and Unit of Work contracts over a logical transaction boundary for coordination state and dispatch outbox.
nodes.forbidden_inference: The research and canonical architecture select no database or ORM and exclude Operation business state and Operation outbox.

nodes.label: Recovery Claim Authority Service
nodes.summary: Acquire one current Claim through version compare-and-set and allocate monotonic fencing tokens.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Claim authority permits dispatch advancement only.

nodes.label: Recovery Claim Lease Service
nodes.summary: Grant and renew latest-generation bounded validity for the current Claim through an injected Clock.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A Lease is not replay protection, retry, or proof of business outcome.

nodes.label: Durable Recovery Worker
nodes.summary: Advance one eligible dispatch under current Claim and Lease, preflight bindings, record Attempts, and delegate effects to Operations.
nodes.forbidden_inference: The replaceable worker owns no durable truth or business effect authority.

nodes.label: Recovery Attempt Journal
nodes.summary: Persist unique executor episodes and succeeded, failed, or unknown outcomes inside the coordination boundary.
nodes.forbidden_inference: An Attempt outcome is not D44 Terminal Disposition.

nodes.label: Operation Invocation Ledger
nodes.summary: Durably recognize stable Invocation Identity and return an already recorded Operation result without repeating its semantic effect.
nodes.forbidden_inference: The compensation coordinator cannot own or fabricate Operation semantic deduplication.

nodes.label: Recovery Retry Scheduler
nodes.summary: Persist explicit continuation, policy, budget, and not-before before the same occurrence becomes eligible.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Retry cannot replan, substitute an Operation, or invent continuation authority.

nodes.label: Recovery Terminal Recorder
nodes.summary: Commit completed, exhausted, or escalated from the required durable evidence with no implicit successor.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Terminal recording is not successor selection, publication, or deployment.

nodes.label: Recovery Restart Reconciler
nodes.summary: Recover expired authority and interrupted Attempts, then resume from the first incomplete plan occurrence.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Restart cannot change semantic identity or turn unknown into proven failure.

nodes.label: Dispatch Outbox Publisher
nodes.summary: Publish committed dispatch outbox records at least once without authoring coordination state.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Message delivery or duplication cannot decide dispatch truth.

nodes.label: Recovery Clock Contract
nodes.summary: Generated responsibility-specific contract formation supplies comparable time for Lease validity and Retry eligibility.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Generated contract formation is not a runtime clock and cannot override committed generations or fencing.

nodes.label: Recovery Wakeup Contract
nodes.summary: Generated responsibility-specific contract formation makes polling or notification discovery explicit without authoring state.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Generated contract formation is not delivery, committed dispatch state, or execution authority.

nodes.label: Recovery Telemetry Contract
nodes.summary: Observe committed transitions, authority, Attempts, Retries, Terminal Disposition, restart, and publication lag.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Telemetry cannot execute, authorize, or repair a transition and is not a universal Port.

nodes.label: Instantiation and Compensation Contract Tests
nodes.summary: Positive and hostile fixtures exercise generation, relationship closure, three-language recovery parity, D45-D49 formation, receipt binding, exact observation, and execution boundaries.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Passing repository tests do not authorize provider selection, baseline selection, publication, or untested durable runtime behavior.
